answer: Locks are published in bridge, expire in oasis, and sable lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 67 aliases therefore needs 187 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 556 identities would post 571 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
